title: Precompose adapter mixture codes before execution
hypothesis: For a layerwise input-dependent mixture of aligned LoRA experts, composing gate-weighted Mirror coordinates before applying a shared rank-R atom basis preserves outputs while reducing active adapter MACs versus evaluating each of E experts. A Mirror-specific gain requires improvement over native coefficient-space precomposition.
physical_object: One dense base matrix and a shared rank-4 LoRA atom basis
mirror_coordinate: Per-expert coefficients over shared rank-1 update atoms, mixed by an input-conditioned gate
logical_multiplicity: 16 logical adapters mixed dynamically into one effective per-input adapter

task.metric: output NRMSE, actual serialized complete payload bytes, active MAC proxy, CPU inference wall time

development.selection_metric: Exact output/error and storage/active-MAC Pareto; no tuning after fresh access

controls: Full independent LoRA bank: evaluate all expert updates then gate and sum
Mirror atom-code precomposition: gate and sum expert codes before applying atom outputs
Native low-rank coefficient-space precomposition with the same factors and runtime algebra
Full independent-bank top-2 execution as sparse compute reference

storage.authority: Actual serialized complete inference payload bytes
paid_objects: expert factors or shared atoms and codes

compute: active adapter MAC proxy per input
success_gate: At rho=0, precomposed path must have output NRMSE <=1e-6, payload <=60% of full bank, and active adapter MACs <=50% of full bank. A Mirror-specific finding additionally requires strict Pareto improvement over native coefficient-space precomposition. At rho=.05, report quality/bytes with and without private rank-2 residual.
failure_gate: Any quality gate miss or exact functional/state alias to native precomposition without strict Pareto gain. If exact alias is observed during development, fresh remains sealed.
boundaries: Synthetic one-layer regression screen only; no natural MoLE or LM claim
The full bank and top-2 controls share the same input router and expert teacher
Fresh seeds stay sealed after exact native alias
Logical expert count is not interpreted as independent capacity

Implementation amendment before rerun: preserve initial attempt under source/attempts/initial_axis_bug; correct input-axis contraction and account for router and adapter MACs consistently for each method.

Amendment before corrected rerun: initial precomposition materialized dense atoms and its top-2 control evaluated every expert; preserve under source/attempts/initial_dense_atom_unpruned_top2. Corrected precomposition evaluates factored U/V paths; corrected top-2 evaluates selected experts only; rank-2 private residual controls are included at rho=.05. Fresh remains sealed.
